large_rule: Current TR >= 2 times arithmetic mean of previous six valid completed 10-minute TRs. Require uninterrupted bars; reset at gap or roll. No Wilder smoothing.
event_rule: One maximal uninterrupted non-doji same-colour run; qualify at second close if first two are large, otherwise third close if present. Count once. Boundaries: doji/opposite colour/gap/roll/file edge.
hour_rule: Confirmation timestamp = qualifying bar opening +10 minutes; allocate to clock hour containing confirmation. Denominator = six exact complete ten-minute bars in that UTC hour, same roll segment; label with New York clock hour. Full run can start before or end after that hour.
period_rule: New York 18:00–17:00 session; trading date is local date +1 after18:00; phase from confirmation hour trading date. Remove17:00–18:00 before aggregation.
scope: New declared long-history reconstruction, not original unrecovered 10-minute export/window-rank replication. Retrospective observed run size, not executable trade profit.
contract_exclusion: Exclude missing contract identities rather than guess them. Retain provided roll flags before filtering; require every adjacent known identity change to have a roll flag.
